facts.text: SLS Cancun sits in Puerto Cancun's luxury marina community.
facts.excerpt: Make your entrance in the heart of Puerto Cancún’s luxury marina community

facts.text: The suites were designed by architect and designer Piero Lissoni.
facts.excerpt: Designed by internationally renowned architect and designer Piero Lissoni

facts.text: The interiors pair a nautical white-and-navy palette with mid-century-inspired furnishings and wall coverings that draw on Maya motifs.
facts.excerpt: pair a vaguely nautical white-and-navy palette with low-slung, mid-century-inspired furnishings and bold wall coverings that draw on Maya motifs

facts.text: The hotel opened in 2021 as SLS Hotels & Resorts' first property in Mexico.
facts.excerpt: SLS Hotels & Resorts finally expanded into Mexico with the 2021 opening of this beachside tower

facts.text: Deluxe Oceanfront King rooms have a furnished step-out balcony with a hammock.
facts.excerpt: featuring a 161 sq ft furnished step-out balcony with a hammock

facts.text: Suites have a rain shower and an oval tub.
facts.excerpt: a living room with single daybed, two TVs, an elegant rain shower and an oval tub

facts.text: Cleo restaurant offers a modern take on classic Levantine cuisine.
facts.excerpt: giving it a modern take on classic Levantine cuisine

facts.text: Bungalow Pool & Beach Club has an eco-chic design inspired by the French Riviera.
facts.excerpt: With lively atmosphere and an eco-chic design inspired by the French Riviera, Bungalow Pool & Beach Club combines cocktails, food, and entertainment

facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool overlooking the Gulf of Mexico and a private beach.
facts.excerpt: Take a lap in a luxurious infinity pool overlooking the Gulf of Mexico, and relax on our private beach.

facts.text: Ciel Spa has herbal steam rooms, a relaxation lounge and a massage suite.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in the relaxation lounge, massage suite, herbal steam rooms, spacious experience showers, custom massage beds, fitness center and much more.

facts.text: The gym schedules yoga, pilates and salsa classes.
facts.excerpt: plus a schedule of yoga, pilates and salsa classes

facts.text: Guests get access to an 18-hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf.
facts.excerpt: SLS Cancun guests receive access to an exclusive 18-hole Tom Weiskopf-designed golf course.

facts.text: Golf prices are set and paid at the Clubhouse.
facts.excerpt: Prices are set and payment is collected at the Clubhouse; prices may vary.

facts.text: Private yacht excursions depart from and return to SLS Cancun.
facts.excerpt: Choose from an array of experiences, each departing and returning to SLS Cancun, and each unforgettable.

facts.text: Yacht options include fishing and scuba diving trips.
facts.excerpt: Yacht and Scuba Diving (PADI not required): Explore the underwater world effortlessly.

facts.text: Private poolside cabanas come with concierge service.
facts.excerpt: Reserve one of four private cabanas by the pool, complete with concierge service

facts.text: Cabana rentals and day passes are for adults 18 and over; children are permitted only as hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Adults 18+ only. Children are permitted as hotel guests only.

facts.text: Outside visitors can buy pool and beach access through ResortPass.
facts.excerpt: Reserve a visit to SLS Cancun with ResortPass and receive access to the outdoor pool, white-sand beach, complimentary events and more.

facts.text: The development around the hotel includes a 175-slip private marina, boutiques and movie theaters.
facts.excerpt: The 45-room property anchors a development that includes a beach club, a 175-slip private marina, more than 100 boutiques, movie theaters

facts.text: The hotel offers mixology and cooking classes.
facts.excerpt: From a private marina and exclusive island golf course to mixology and cooking classes

facts.text: Just Be Nice Travel Cancun is the airport transfer company recommended by the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Just Be Nice Travel Cancun, the only airport transfers recommended by SLS Cancun

facts.text: The golf course sits on an island in Puerto Cancun's main canal.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on a captivating island in the heart of Puerto Cancun

facts.text: The hotel calls Ciel Spa one of the best spa experiences in Cancun.
facts.excerpt: one of the best spa experiences in all of Cancún
